message: No detected input validation: The code only sets up GUI widgets and connects signals; there is no schema check, dtype assertion, or value-range guard on any incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Although 'requests' is imported and a 'detect_version()' call is present, no checksum verification, signature check, or pinned revision is visible for any remote fetch in the provided code slice.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code is primarily GUI wiring (PyQt5 setup, stylesheet loading) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code is a GUI launcher that initializes UI components and connects signals; there is no loading of pretrained weights or serialized models, and consequently no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision control.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the provided slice checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The code contains only GUI wiring and stylesheet loading; there is no backdoor defense, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly analysis anywhere in the slice.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or invoked anywhere in the provided code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or related logic are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The visible code is primarily GUI scaffolding with no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metric verification mechanisms.
No detected input sanitization: The code shows only GUI initialization and event wiring with no visible input validation, schema checks, or shape/range guards on data passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that inspects, bounds-checks, or filters model outputs (e.g., probability ranges, NaN guards) before returning results to the user.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML classification/regression models (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
